protocol.strict_success: both final-30 and final-100 mean error < 1 cm and max error < 2 cm
experimental_factors: graph-routed waypoint reference versus final reference only
always-online contextual selection versus causally triggered rescue
online trajectory rescue versus cached contextual chart-union rescue
protocol.shared_local_representation: centered rank-60 SVD with the same coefficient bounds; Atlas precomputed offline, online selectors rebuilt every step
protocol.online_timing_includes: localization/routing where used + selection + SVD rebuild + QP solve
protocol.closed_loop_cost: sum_t (y_t-r_t)^T Q (y_t-r_t) + u_t^T R u_t, where r_t is the waypoint/final reference active during control interval t
protocol.secondary_final_goal_cost: the previous common-final-goal metric is retained separately as median_closed_loop_final_goal_cost
protocol.timing_note: This parallel batch is used for outcome statistics. Refer to the single-seed controlled notebook cells for fair serial timing.
